findings.evidence: Exp.lean:136-139 `exp_zsmul_conj_mem … := mul_mem (mul_mem (exp_zsmul_mem hx hS t) hb) (exp_zsmul_mem hx hS (-t))` vs Exponential.lean:89-91 `mul_mem (mul_mem (exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm e h f hnil t) hb) (exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm e h f hnil (-t))`; `grep -rn "exp_zsmul_conj_mem" TauCeti` returns only the two declarations.
findings.fix: Factor the divided-power membership out of `exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm` (lines 77-79 and the same `rw [← Associative.map_dividedPower …]; exact dividedPower_mem_kostantForm …` shape at lines 126-127) into a lemma `dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm : ∀ n, Associative.dividedPower n (f (ι ℚ (e i))) ∈ (kostantForm e h).map f`, then prove the conjugation lemma as `exp_zsmul_conj_mem hnil (dividedPower_mem_map_kostantForm e h f i) t hb`.
findings.issue: `exp_zsmul_conj_mem_map_kostantForm` re-proves `TauCeti.exp_zsmul_conj_mem` (TauCeti/RingTheory/Nilpotent/Exp.lean:136) with the identical `mul_mem (mul_mem (…mem… t) hb) (…mem… (-t))` chain instead of applying it; grep shows the generic lemma has no consumer anywhere in the repo, so the PR ships both a general lemma and a hand-repeated instance of it.

findings.evidence: Exp.lean:131-133 `coe_expSMulHom … : ((expSMulHom hx t : Aˣ) : A) = exp (… • x) := rfl`; Exponential.lean:101-103 proof is `rw [coe_expSMulHom]; exact exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm e h f hnil _`.
findings.fix: Delete `coe_expSMulHom_mem_map_kostantForm` (and its entry in the module docstring's main results); consumers holding the hom get it by `simpa using exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm e h f hnil (Multiplicative.toAdd t)`, since `coe_expSMulHom` is already `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `coe_expSMulHom_mem_map_kostantForm` is `exp_zsmul_mem_map_kostantForm` restated up to defeq: `TauCeti.coe_expSMulHom` (Exp.lean:131-133) is proved by `rfl`, so `((expSMulHom hnil t : Aˣ) : A) ∈ S` is the same proposition as `exp ((toAdd t : ℚ) • …) ∈ S`. It adds a second public name for one fact.

summary: No duplication of Mathlib or existing TauCeti material; the new results genuinely extend Mathlib's nilpotent-exponential API. Two in-diff duplications: the Kostant conjugation lemma re-derives the generic one it should apply (leaving the generic one dead), and the `expSMulHom` membership lemma restates the preceding lemma up to a `rfl` coercion.
